title: 第12章  老部队来人给军训！
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
林毅有些不确定他老爸这一句问候，是有些动摇了，还是故意想要讽刺他。
他点点头：“嗯，必须要回。”
林国栋翕动了下嘴巴，却没说话。
注视他良久，他冷哼一声，不紧不慢的走到了车旁。
拉开副驾驶的门，随后独自走向了主驾驶。
林毅自然明白是什么意思，把行李往车上一放，直接坐到了副驾驶。
汽车缓缓驶离，朝着烟城一中的方向驶去。
一路上，父子俩谁都没说话，都板着脸，默不作声。
没多久，抵达学校。
林国栋什么都没说，林毅下了车后，他就把车开走了，速度挺快。
林毅看着远去的车辆，嘀咕道：“就不到两公里的路，还至于过来送一下？”
回想起这一路上，老爸无数次欲言又止的样子，他才不信老爸不想跟自己说点什么。
可父子关系就是这样，在意见出现分歧之后，谁都不会选择低头，只会固执的认为自己是对的。
事实上，谁都没错。
但事情发展到这一步，说什么也都没啥用了，除非老爸真的愿意走后门，让自己重回部队。
不然，他还是得老老实实的考军校，靠自己的努力重回部队！
抛开杂念，林毅拖着行李走进校园。
复读生报到流程简单快捷，登记信息、领取宿舍钥匙和生活用品，还有军训服装。
按照分配，他的宿舍在四楼四零二寝室，六人间。
林毅提着箱子上楼，推开宿舍门的时候，里面已经坐了五个男生，清一色青涩稚嫩的少年面孔，都是十八九岁的年纪，满脸青春朝气，一看就是去年高考失利，今年立刻就过来复读的高四生。

几人闻声抬头，看到门口的林毅，集体愣住，眼神里写满了惊奇。
林毅一米八几的挺拔个子，身姿笔直，脸上完全没有稚嫩青涩的感觉，一看就比他们大很多。
宿舍里几个舍友面面相觑，心里都暗自嘀咕。
他们之前就在网上刷到过，有些复读班会有年纪偏大的高十，甚至十几生，属于是传说级别的复读生，万万没想到自己宿舍居然真能分到一位。
活久见啊，今天真是小刀拉屁股，开了眼儿了！
林毅看着几个小家伙一脸好奇的模样，也不端架子，依旧是那副吊儿郎当的样子：“哈喽，各位新舍友，我叫林毅，跟你们一样是复读的，以后多多关照。”
几个少年放下拘谨，纷纷热情回应，自我介绍、搭话闲聊。
林毅仗着比他们年纪大，又在部队里混了这么多年，比这些小男生强多了，也很懂他们这些小男生的想法，气氛很快活络起来。
只有短短十几分钟，几人就打成一片，互道兄弟了。
闲聊间，不知是谁随口问了一句林毅的过往。
林毅也没隐瞒，直接把他当了六年兵的事情说了，只是把三进三出的事情隐瞒了，毕竟不是很光彩。
而得知他是退伍老兵时，几个舍友眼睛放光，立刻来了兴致。
“卧槽！毅哥你当过兵？还是六年老兵？”
“我的天，太酷了吧！快讲讲快讲讲，部队里面是不是特别有意思？有没有什么趣事？”
几人满脸憧憬，在普通学生眼里，军营生活神秘又热血，满是滤镜，一个个眼巴巴等着听故事。
林毅靠在床铺栏杆上，一脸唏嘘：“趣事？哪有什么趣事，纯几把遭罪。”
他侃侃而谈道：“每天六点准时起床，叠被子、整内务、跑五公里，刮风下雨雷打不动，白天高强度训练，体能、战术、队列轮番来，累得你胳膊腿都不是自己的。”
“而且部队纪律严得离谱，第一年你是压根别想碰到手机，第二年能稍微好一点，但玩手机也有时间限制。”
“还有什么出门要报备啦，去小卖部买东西也得偷偷去啦，一言一行都得守规矩啦。”
“对，还有沟槽的班长，他妈的，一个个眼睛毒辣得很，一点小毛病都能被抓着训，嘴上说着给你提干，等到了宿舍就是提起来，狠狠地干你！”

“说句实话，部队那地方就不是人待的，你们啊，老老实实复读，上了好大学比去部队强多了。”
几个少年听完后，顿时目瞪口呆。
原本脑补的热血军旅、潇洒帅气，成为特种兵，执行绝密任务，然后凯旋归来，迎接万人敬仰的场景，当即碎得稀碎……
几人纷纷咂舌，一脸后怕：“啊？原来部队这么苦啊？听着也太折磨人了吧！”
看着小家伙们被吓到的样子，林毅嘴角微微一勾，话锋陡然一转。
“不过话说回来，苦是真的苦，但好处也是真的多。”
“六年军营，磨的是性子、练的是体魄、长的是担当，在里面待过的人，自律、韧劲、抗压能力，都不是普通人能比的。”
“那些战友之间的感情吧，很纯粹，跟其他的交情都不一样，那句话咋说来说，一起同过窗，一起扛过枪，一起分过脏，外加一起嫖过娼，四种最铁的关系，扛过枪绝对排第一！”
“而且吧，在部队待着，确实会让你有那种守护家国的归属感，完成任务的成就感，是外面任何东西都换不来的。”
几个舍友被他整懵了，一脸呆呆的，脑子都有点转不过来。
“那所以……部队到底是好还是不好啊？”
林毅哈哈一笑，吊儿郎当摆手：“因人而异吧，怕苦的话，那就是地狱。”
几人只能跟着连连点头，思绪发散。
宿舍欢声笑语不断，聊着聊着，林毅脑海里突然闪过一件事。
明天全校就要开启军训，复读班也不例外。
话说……这次学校请来的军训教官，不会有自己老部队的人吧？
如果再设想一下，如果老刘来了会怎么样？
到时候，明天军训一开始，老刘正严肃的教训学生呢，转头一看自己就在队列里，刘畅估计能当场洒泪吧，那画面可就太精彩了。
毕竟，自己退伍走的时候，这家伙就憋着泪呢。
林毅越想越觉得有意思，嘴角忍不住上扬。

但下一秒，他就直接否定了这个离谱的猜想。
想多了。
全国这么多军训教官，老部队这么多战友，怎么可能巧到这种地步？
烟城一中校门口。
两辆制式军车匀速开进校门，停靠在行政楼下。
此时的后排座位上，正坐着一身作训服，精神抖擞准备大干一场的王冲。
content_en:
Ji Yi was a little unsure whether his father was shaken by his greeting, or whether he was deliberately trying to ridicule him.
He nodded: "Well, I have to go back."
Lin Guodong moved his mouth but said nothing.
After staring at him for a long time, he snorted coldly and walked slowly to the car.
He opened the passenger door and walked to the main driver alone.
Lin Yi naturally understood what it meant. He put his luggage in the car and sat directly in the passenger seat.
The car drove away slowly, heading in the direction of Yancheng No. 1 Middle School.
Along the way, neither father nor son spoke. They both had straight faces and remained silent.
Not long after, we arrived at school.
Lin Guodong didn't say anything. After Lin Yi got out of the car, he drove away very quickly.
Ji Yi looked at the passing vehicles and muttered: "It's less than two kilometers away, why don't you come here to see me off?"
Recalling the way his father hesitated to speak countless times along the way, he couldn't believe that his father didn't want to say something to him.
But the relationship between father and son is like this. After differences of opinion, no one will choose to bow their head, and will only stubbornly believe that they are right.
In fact, no one is right.
But when things have reached this point, it's useless to say anything, unless dad is really willing to go through the back door and let himself return to the army.
Otherwise, he would still have to pass the military academy exams and return to the army through his own efforts!
Putting aside distracting thoughts, Ji Yi dragged his luggage into the campus.
The registration process for repeat students is simple and fast, including registering information, receiving dormitory keys and daily necessities, as well as military training uniforms.
According to the allocation, his dormitory is in dormitory 402 on the fourth floor, a six-person room.
Lin Yi carried the suitcase upstairs and opened the door to the dormitory. Five boys were already sitting inside. They were all young boys with green and tender faces. They were all eighteen or nineteen years old. Their faces were full of youth and vitality. At first glance, they were high school seniors who failed the college entrance examination last year and came here to repeat their studies immediately this year.
Several people looked up when they heard the sound and saw Ji Yi at the door. They were all stunned, their eyes full of surprise.
Lin Yi is tall and tall, about 1.8 meters tall, with an upright posture. There is no immature look on his face at all. He looks much older than them at first glance.
Several roommates in the dormitory looked at each other, muttering to themselves.
They had seen on the Internet before that some repeating classes would have older tenth or even ten-year-old students who were legendary repeating students. They never expected that they would actually get one in their dormitory.
See you soon, today is really a knife in the butt, it opened my eyes!
Lin Yi looked at the curious expressions on the faces of the few little guys. He did not put on any airs, but still looked carefree: "Hello, new roommates, my name is Lin Yi. I am a repeat student like you. Please take care of me in the future."
Several teenagers put aside their restraints and responded enthusiastically, introducing themselves and chatting.
Because Lin Yi is older than them and has been in the army for so many years, he is much better than these little boys. He also understands the thoughts of these little boys very well, and the atmosphere quickly became lively.
In just ten minutes, a few people got along well and called each other brothers.
During the chat, someone casually asked about Ji Yi's past.
Ji Yi didn't hide anything. He directly told him that he had been a soldier for six years. He just concealed the three in and three out events. After all, it was not very honorable.
When they learned that he was a veteran, several roommates' eyes lit up and they immediately became interested.
"Shit! Brother Yi, have you ever been in the military? Or are you a six-year veteran?"
"Oh my god, it's so cool! Tell me, tell me, tell me. Isn't it particularly interesting in the army? Are there any interesting things?"
Several people's faces were full of longing. In the eyes of ordinary students, life in the military camp is mysterious and passionate, full of filters, and everyone is eagerly waiting to hear the story.
Ji Yi leaned on the railing of the bed, with a sigh on his face: "Funny story? There is no funny story, just a few misfortunes."
He talked eloquently: "I get up on time at six o'clock every day, fold the quilt, do housework, run five kilometers, shaveRain, rain, and thunder can't stop you. High-intensity training during the day, physical fitness, tactics, and formations take turns, so tired that your arms and legs are no longer your own. "
"And the discipline of the army is ridiculously strict. In the first year, you don't even want to touch a mobile phone. In the second year, it's a little better, but there is a time limit for using mobile phones. "
"There are other things that I have to report when I go out, I have to go to the canteen to buy things secretly, and I have to abide by the rules in everything I say and do. "
"Yes, there are also monitors in the trenches. Damn, they all have very vicious eyes. They can be caught and scolded for the slightest problem. They talk about lifting you up, and when they get to the dormitory, they lift you up and fuck you hard!" "
"To be honest, the army is not a place for people. You guys, just repeat your studies honestly. Going to a good university is much better than going to the army. "
After hearing this, several teenagers were stunned.
The original idea of a hot-blooded military soldier, a dashing and handsome man, becoming a special forces soldier, performing a top-secret mission, and then returning in triumph to greet the admiration of thousands of people, was immediately shattered into pieces...
Several people smacked their tongues with fear on their faces: "Huh? So the army is so miserable? It sounds too torturous! "
Seeing how the little guys were frightened, Ji Yi raised the corner of his mouth slightly and suddenly changed the subject.
“But having said that, the pain is really hard, but the benefits are also really many. "
“Six years in the military camp have honed your temperament, trained your physique, and grown your sense of responsibility. The self-discipline, tenacity, and ability to withstand pressure of those who have stayed in it are beyond the comparison of ordinary people. "
"The relationship between comrades-in-arms is very pure, and it is different from other friendships. How can I put it in other words? We have been in the same window together, we have carried guns together, we have shared our dirty laundry together, and we have gone to prostitutes together. Among the four most iron-clad relationships, having carried guns together is definitely the first! "
"Besides, staying in the army will indeed give you a sense of belonging in protecting your homeland and a sense of accomplishment in completing a mission, which cannot be exchanged for anything outside. "
Several roommates were confused by him, their faces were blank, and their minds were a little hard to turn around.
"So...are the troops good or bad? "
Lin Yi laughed and waved his hands carelessly: "It depends on the person. If you are afraid of hardship, it will be hell. "
Several people could only nod their heads, their thoughts diverging.
The dormitory was full of laughter and chatting, and something suddenly flashed in Ji Yi's mind.
Tomorrow the whole school will start military training, and the repeat class is no exception.
By the way... the military training instructors invited by the school this time will not be from their own old army, right?
If you imagine again, what would happen if Lao Liu came?
When the military training begins tomorrow, Old Liu is seriously lecturing the students. When he turns around and sees that he is in the queue, Liu Chang will probably shed tears on the spot. The scene is so exciting.
After all, when he was discharged from the army, this guy was holding back tears.
The more Ji Yi thought about it, the more interesting it became, and he couldn't help but raise the corners of his mouth.
But the next second, he directly denied this outrageous conjecture.
Thinking too much.
With so many military training instructors across the country and so many comrades in the old army, how could it happen that this happened?
The gate of Yancheng No. 1 Lieutenant Colonel.
Two standard military vehicles drove into the school gate at a constant speed and parked under the administrative building.
At this time, sitting in the back seat was Wang Chong, who was dressed in training uniform and was full of energy and ready to fight.
